categories.main_business_segments: Qisda Corporation operates primarily in four business segments: display products including LCD and OLED monitors with a global market presence; projector products serving commercial, educational, and home entertainment markets; medical services through its hospitals in Nanjing and Suzhou, China; and smart solutions and network communications. The company also invests in healthcare-related businesses and digital transformation solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced display technologies such as QD-OLED, W-OLED with dual mode support, and high refresh rate LCD panels. It integrates vertical manufacturing processes including panel module assembly and backlight module design to enhance product value. In projection, it utilizes LED and laser light sources for high-brightness and high-resolution projectors. Medical services incorporate smart hospital platforms and AI-assisted diagnostic tools. The company maintains ISO certifications for environmental and information security management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Qisda serves global markets for its display and projector products, targeting consumer electronics, gaming, professional design, and industrial sectors. Its medical services primarily target patients in the Chinese mainland, especially in Jiangsu province. The company’s smart solutions and network communications cater to telecommunications and enterprise customers, including expansion into the Indian market and satellite communications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing and R&D facilities mainly in Taiwan, China (Suzhou and Nanjing), and Vietnam. Its sales and service markets are global for electronic products, with medical services concentrated in China. It also pursues expansion in Asia-Pacific and emerging markets such as India.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qisda operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on design, assembly, and integration of display modules and projectors. It maintains close partnerships with upstream panel and component suppliers and engages in vertical integration to increase value-added manufacturing. The company also extends downstream into medical services and smart solutions, integrating hardware and software offerings.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in high-refresh-rate OLED and LCD displays, AI-enabled smart medical platforms, and advanced projection technologies including 4K UHD and laser light sources. It invests in expanding medical services and smart hospital capabilities, as well as developing AI applications for healthcare and digital transformation. Sustainability and ESG goals guide R&D towards green products and energy efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Qisda generates revenue primarily through product sales of electronic displays and projectors, medical service fees from hospital operations, and sales of smart solutions and network communication services. It also earns licensing fees from technology patents and strategic investments in related businesses.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds the global second-largest market share in DMS display products and ranks third globally in projector products. It competes with major panel manufacturers and projector brands, leveraging vertical integration and technology innovation to maintain leadership. In medical services, it is a leading private hospital group in East China, competing with public and private healthcare providers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Qisda reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$201.7 billion, a slight decrease of 1% from the previous year, with operating profit of NT$4.52 billion and net profit of NT$2.81 billion. The company maintains a strong asset base of over NT$206 billion and equity of NT$66.4 billion. It has shown stable growth in high-margin medical and smart solution businesses, with ongoing investments in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qisda differentiates itself through advanced display technologies offering high refresh rates, professional color management, and specialized medical displays. Its vertical integration enhances product quality and customization capabilities. The company’s medical services emphasize high-quality, differentiated care with smart hospital platforms and AI integration. Sustainability leadership and comprehensive ESG practices further strengthen its competitive positioning.
